title: Fix Bidirectional Hover in Sketchpad Design App
description: Refactor sketchpad to fix bidirectional hover. Currently only diagram hover leads to synced hover in the scene but not the other way around. Scene hover should also sync to diagram.
summary: Fixed bidirectional hover synchronization between diagram and scene windows in the design app. Root cause: Two separate hover consumption mechanisms read from different sources. The diagram read hover from the XState actor, while the scene read hover from the DesignStore. The diagram commands only wrote to the actor, not the DesignStore, causing one-way sync. Changes: 1. Refactored HoverPiecesProviderInner to subscribe to both the DesignStore AND the XState actor for hover changes. 2. Updated all hover commands to also call store.change() to update the DesignStore synchronously. 3. Fixed bug in useDesignAppHover setter where SET_HOVER was only sent for pieces/connections, missing types/designs/connectors hover.
